header.running_head: Reprimanding those who Occupy Themselves with Learning Things that are Contrary to that Which Rasulullaah ﷺ Taught

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) Rebukes a man who Wrote the Scripture of Hadhrat Daaniyaal (AS) and His Incident with Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Khaalid bin Urfuta narrates that he was with Hadhrat Umar (RA) when a man from the Abdul Qais tribe was brought. The man lived in a place called Soos (where Hadhrat Daaniyaal (AS) is believed to be buried). When Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked him whether he was a particular person from the Abd tribe, the man replied that he was. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then struck him with a staff that he had with him. "O Ameerul Mu'mineen!" the man cried, "What have I done?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) told him to sit down and when he did, Hadhrat Umar (RA) recited the following:

blocks.arabic_text: الٓرٰ ۚ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۝ إِنَّآ أَنْزَلْنٰهُ قُرْءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ ۝ نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هٰذَا الْقُرْءٰنَ ۖ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَمِنَ الْغٰفِلِيْنَ ۝
blocks.text: In the name of Allaah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Alif Laam Raa. These are the verses of the clear Book (the Qur'aan). Undoubtedly We have revealed it (the Qur'aan) as an Arabic Qur'aan so that you may understand. We narrate to you a most beautiful story in this Qur'aan that We reveal to you. Before this you were of the unwary.

Hadhrat Umar (RA) recited the verses thrice and hit the man thrice. Again the man asked, "What have I done, O Ameerul Mu'mineen?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "You are the person who wrote the scriptures of Daaniyaal (AS)." "I am prepared to do whatever you instruct me," the man said. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said to him, "Go and erase it with (pouring) hot water (over it) and (the wiping with) white wool. I neither want you to read it or to give it to anyone else to read. If the news reaches me that you had read it or had given it to someone else to read, I shall punish you very severely."

Hadhrat Umar (RA) then told the man to sit down, and when he sat in front of Hadhrat Umar (RA), the Ameerul Mu'mineen narrated, "I once copied a scripture from the Ahlul Kitaab on a piece of leather. When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked me what it was I had in my hand, I said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! It is a scripture that I copied to supplement the knowledge we have.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then became so angry that his cheeks flamed red. (By the instruction of Rasulullaah ﷺ) The announcement 'As Salaatu Jaami'ah' was made (to gather the people), to which the Ansaar said, 'Take your weapons! Take your weapons! Your Nabi ﷺ has been angered.' The people then amassed around Rasulullaah ﷺ's pulpit. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'O people! I have been granted speech that is comprehensive, conclusive, yet very concise.
